name: Green Smoothie Basics
instructions: Start with a mild green (spinach) before working up to stronger ones (kale) -- it blends in without changing the taste much.
Use a plant milk or water as your liquid base to keep the smoothie fully plant-based.
Add a plant protein (hemp seeds, a scoop of pea protein, or nut butter) so the smoothie holds you over, not just a sugar spike.
Watch today's video for smoothie recipes, then build your own green version from the same formula.
